description.text:
ᴘᴜʀᴘᴏsᴇ ᴏғ ᴛʜɪs ᴘᴏsɪᴛɪᴏɴ
Moxa IT is a professional information technology team to handle business application systems and IT infrastructure globally. We are looking for creative & self-motivate talent to join as to build up world class business platform. The candidate should equip with solid technology background and rich experience. Hands-on experience for business application implementation upon either cloud or on-premised is also the key criteria.
Manage/ Engage of Key Initiatives and make business unit to success via ensure successful engagements and project go-lives. Start from analyzing business requirements, variances, and solution assessment then as project manager to lead implementation.
ᴍᴀᴊᴏʀ ᴀʀᴇᴀs ᴏғ ʀᴇsᴘᴏɴsɪʙɪʟɪᴛʏ
1. 負責Customer facing相關Web應用服務開發與維護工作
2. 負責Web應用服務系統測試規劃與執行
3. 依據SA/SD文件，進行Web應用系統之程式開發，並協助專案經理進行專案可行性評估、時程安排以及專案文件之撰寫交付
4. 使用者教育訓練與系統上線
5. 系統上線後負起維護與持續改善的責任

• 2至3年軟體開發與維運經驗
